top_comments.body: I also encountered the same problem. I suddenly found that the Claude code button couldn't be found in cursor ui, and then the claude command couldn't be found in the terminal either. So I tried to reinstall claude code, but this error was returned during the installation. I tried to uninstall it but still returned this error

top_comments.author: Williamleejx
top_comments.body:
I find the following method can work.
Firstly, use the `rm -rf` command to delete the directory of your Claude Code. Secondly, reinstall it!
